posts.title: Update.
posts.content:
BotNexus Update Log
September 2, 2026
Dashboard and Verification session synchronization
Dashboard and Verification now use one shared session cookie.
Expired or stale session cookies are cleared automatically on either page.
Logout clears the dashboard session and temporary OAuth cookies.
Logout synchronizes across open Dashboard and Verification tabs.
Verification can no longer continue displaying a signed-in Discord profile after the shared session has ended.
Roblox account links remain persistent after Discord logout by design.
Roblox accounts must still be removed separately with the Unlink Account action.
